item.title: New open-source toolkit improves evaluation of tool-using AI agents
item.description: The toolkit records tool selection, arguments, execution results and recovery behaviour. It is designed to help developers compare agent workflows with repeatable tests.

item.title: Researchers study probability calibration for clinical prediction models
item.description: The study examines how calibration changes across hospitals and patient groups. It recommends reporting calibration alongside discrimination metrics.

item.title: Compact vision model targets faster image classification
item.description: A smaller neural network architecture reduces inference requirements for image tasks. The release includes evaluation results and implementation details.
